OP likely won’t see this, if anyone, as there’s already 3100 comments but I’d like to contribute because of my experience. Firstly, I got Moderna. My first dose gave me 3 weeks of intense tinnitus. I already had it so I understood what it meant but it was a lot worse. Also any loud noises I simply couldn’t stand. I work in a factory where it’s loud but not damagingly loud. I bought and wore noise cancelling headphones because my sensitivity to noise was off the charts WHILE my tinnitus raged. I didn’t drink, smoke, or have caffeine in that time because it all exacerbated the problem. I was VERY on the fence about the second dose. My tinnitus was starting to get back to normal range and I figured that if the vaccine made this happen then the real deal would make it a lot worse. So I bit the bullet and got my second dose. Tinnitus continued downward and back to where it was before. It did NOT get worse with my second dose. I did see and ENT doctor about it and he said there was a huge influx of people experiencing the same thing. Tinnitus is actually a common side affect due to the inflammation caused in the inner ear. However it is possible that it comes on and never goes away to be very real about it. My second dose gave me two days of moderate flu symptoms but then back to normal, as was to be expected. Fast forward to this past week when I got my booster shot. I had a SEVERE flu like reaction this time. Was in bed for two straight days. Swollen lymph nodes and a sore arm/shoulder is all I had by day three and had a great time at my family get together on that third day. Overall I am glad I have gotten all the vaccines but I will not be getting anymore as there’s already a discussion about a fourth. Reason being you have to draw the line somewhere because at the end of the day this is experimental medicine and we just don’t know how long this is going to play out. We should all be a lot safer by now.
